description: Household money and admin. Two requests owe a stored limit (a Premium Bonds cash-in's lead time, the gym's notice period), each beside a look-alike from another year or club; the rest act on things no stored item changes, though they share its words.

docs.title: Premium Bonds: how cash-ins work
docs.text: Cash-ins of 3,000 GBP or more take 8 working days to reach your bank and are limited to one a week.

docs.title: Premium Bonds update, March 2024
docs.text: From April 2024 cash-ins must be made online; the minimum holding is 25 GBP.

docs.title: FitLab membership: your terms
docs.text: Cancellations need 30 days notice period; the last payment is taken after it ends.

docs.title: Riverside Swim Club renewal
docs.text: Club renewals must be paid by 1 December or the place is released to the waiting list.

docs.title: Council tax instalment
docs.text: Your next council tax instalment of 142 GBP must reach us by 1 December.

docs.title: Shared office: house rules
docs.text: Desks must be cleared by 7pm on Fridays; the printer is restricted to members.

docs.title: Your ISA this tax year
docs.text: You have paid 18,500 GBP of the 20,000 GBP annual limit into ISAs this tax year.

docs.title: Boiler service
docs.text: Tuesday 17 November 08:00-12:00, HeatRight engineer, someone must be in.
